lead.headline: Likely missed Friday, and you carry no other tight end
lead.deck: No designation and a 'minor' groin, so he starts. If he is inactive at 13:55, add Okonkwo for Diggs. Tuten is cleared.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday with a groin injury. Harbaugh called it a 'minor thing' and the Giants gave him no designation, so he starts. But Chem's flex takes no tight end and he is your only one. If Jacksonville–New York inactives at 13:55 Sunday list him, add Chig Okonkwo (free agent, Washington, Monday night, full practice Friday) and drop Stefon Diggs. The good news: Tuten practised on a limited basis Friday and is off Jacksonville's final report, and your 13:54 move put Gordon in for Diggs. That is the projection lineup. One free tweak is left: swap Gordon into an RB slot and Tuten into FLEX, so a late Tuten scratch could still be covered by Waddle, who is cleared, or Diggs. On the Jets, Cooper Jr. and Isaiah Williams are ruled out and Geno Smith is cleared, which is good for Garrett Wilson.

doFirst.headline: Two things before Sunday
doFirst.deck: Swap Gordon and Tuten's slots before noon. At 13:55, check Likely.
doFirst.note: Both are insurance. Neither changes the projection lineup, which you already set at 13:54.
doFirst.empty: No card this run: the lineup is already the projection lineup. The two insurance moves are in the deck above.
